${modID}:SlotMachineStatus.DESCRIPTION: If you have 2 of these cards in your hand, immediately enter Wrath.

${modID}:SlotMachineGame.NAME: Slot Machine Game
${modID}:SlotMachineGame.DESCRIPTION: Add [#efc851ff]Slot [#efc851ff]Machine [#efc851ff]Pull to your hand. Shuffle !M! [#efc851ff]Slot [#efc851ff]Machine [#efc851ff]Eggman into the draw pile. Exhaust.

${modID}:SlotMachinePull.NAME: Slot Machine Pull
${modID}:SlotMachinePull.DESCRIPTION: Draw 1 card. This remains in your hand. If you play another card or your hand is full, Exhaust this.
${modID}:SlotMachinePull.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Draw 1 card. This remains in your hand. If you play another card or your hand is full, discard this.

${modID}:SmoothLanding.NAME: Incorrect Landing
${modID}:SmoothLanding.DESCRIPTION: {@@}Channel 2 Frost. NL If you have Vigor, draw !M! additional card{!M!|>1=s} next turn.
${modID}:SmoothLanding.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: {@@}Channel 2 Frost. NL Draw !M! additional card{!M!|>1=s} next turn.

${modID}:SonicBoom.NAME: Sonic Boom
${modID}:SonicBoom.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. At the end of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your Block and damage modifiers.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. Gain !B! Block. At the end of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your Block and damage modifiers.
Ethereal. Gain !M! Vigor. At the end of your turn, deal damage to ALL enemies equal to your Block and damage modifiers.

${modID}:SonicEagle.NAME: Sonic Eagle
${modID}:SonicEagle.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL If the enemy intends to attack, deal !M! additional damage.

${modID}:SonicFlare.NAME: Sonic Flare
${modID}:SonicFlare.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Gain Vigor by half of the unblocked damage dealt.

${modID}:SonicWave.NAME: Sonic Wave
${modID}:SonicWave.DESCRIPTION: If you have any empty Orb slots, Channel !M! Lightning. Otherwise Evoke ALL Orbs twice and Exhaust.
${modID}:SonicWave.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: If you have any empty Orb slots, Channel !M! Lightning. Otherwise Evoke ALL Orbs twice.

${modID}:SpeedUp.NAME: Speed Up
${modID}:SpeedUp.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust ALL [#efc851ff]Rings in your hand. For each [#efc851ff]Ring exhausted, add a [#efc851ff]Trick to your hand.

${modID}:SpeedBreak.NAME: Speed Break
${modID}:SpeedBreak.DESCRIPTION: Take !M! damage. Reduce the cost of ALL cards in your hand to 0 this turn.

${modID}:SpinDash.NAME: Spin Dash
${modID}:SpinDash.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. The next Attack you play costs 0.

${modID}:SpinningNeedleAttack.NAME: Spinning Needle Atk
${modID}:SpinningNeedleAttack.DESCRIPTION: {@@}Draw 1 card and randomize its cost for this turn. Deal !D! damage. This deals additional damage equal to the randomized cost.
${modID}:SpinningNeedleAttack.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: {@@}Draw 1 card and randomize its cost for this turn. Deal !D! damage. This deals additional damage equal to the randomized cost !M! time{!M!|>1=s}.

${modID}:SuperSonicForm.NAME: Super Sonic Form
${modID}:SuperSonicForm.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Strength and Dexterity. NL At start of turn, lose 1 Dexterity.
${modID}:SuperSonicForm.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Strength, Dexterity, and Focus. NL At start of turn, lose 1 Dexterity and Focus.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Strength. NL Gain !M! Focus. You MUST play your [#efc851ff]Rings to gain Intangible. DIE EVERY TURN.

${modID}:Taunt.NAME: Taunt
${modID}:Taunt.DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Temporary Dexterity. NL Apply !M! Vulnerable. NL This costs 1 less for each Attack played this turn.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Gain !M! Temporary Dexterity. NL Apply !M! Vulnerable. NL This costs 1 less for each Attack played this turn.
Exit your stance. NL Gain !M! Temporary Dexterity. NL Apply !M! Vulnerable. NL This costs 1 less for each Attack played this turn.

${modID}:Teaser.NAME: Teaser
${modID}:Teaser.DESCRIPTION: Channel !M! Dark. NL Shuffle [#efc851ff]Claws [#efc851ff]Unleashed into your draw pile.
${modID}:Teaser.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Channel !M! Dark. NL Shuffle [#efc851ff]Claws [#efc851ff]Unleashed+ into your draw pile.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Channel !M! Dark. NL Shuffle [#efc851ff]Claws [#efc851ff]Unleashed+ into your draw pile.
Channel !M! Dark. NL Shuffle [#efc851ff]Claws [#efc851ff]Unleashed* into your draw pile.

${modID}:TopKick.NAME: Top Kick
${modID}:TopKick.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Vigor. This gains additional Vigor for each Attack played this turn.

${modID}:ThunderShield.NAME: Thunder Shield
${modID}:ThunderShield.DESCRIPTION: Channel !M! Lightning. At end of turn, gain 1 [#efc851ff]Ring. Lightning Orbs trigger an additional time for each [#efc851ff]Ring in your hand.

${modID}:Trick.NAME: Trick
${modID}:Trick.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Gain !M! Vigor. NL Gain 1 [E]. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:TrickFinisher.NAME: Trick Finisher
${modID}:TrickFinisher.DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Double your Vigor. NL Gain 1 [E]. NL Exhaust.
${modID}:TrickFinisher.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Retain. NL Double your Vigor. NL Gain 1 [E].

${modID}:Trickster.NAME: Trickster
${modID}:Trickster.DESCRIPTION: At the start of your turn, add a [#efc851ff]Trick to your hand.
${modID}:Trickster.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL At the start of your turn, add a [#efc851ff]Trick to your hand.

${modID}:TripleKick.NAME: Triple Kick
${modID}:TripleKick.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Temporary Strength. NL Add [#efc851ff]Part [#efc851ff]2 to your hand.
${modID}:TripleKick.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Temporary Strength. NL Add [#efc851ff]Part [#efc851ff]2+ to your hand.

${modID}:TripleKick2.NAME: Triple Kick Part 2
${modID}:TripleKick2.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Temporary Strength. NL Add [#efc851ff]Part [#efc851ff]3 to your hand. Exhaust.
${modID}:TripleKick2.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Temporary Strength. NL Add [#efc851ff]Part [#efc851ff]3+ to your hand. Exhaust.

${modID}:TripleKick3.NAME: Triple Kick Part 3
${modID}:TripleKick3.DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Temporary Strength. Exhaust.
${modID}:TripleKick3.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Ethereal. NL Deal !D! damage. NL Gain !M! Temporary Strength. Exhaust.

${modID}:Turbulence.NAME: Turbulence
${modID}:Turbulence.DESCRIPTION: Lose !M! Focus. NL ${modID}:If_leftmost, add a [#efc851ff]Trick to your hand. Whenever you exhaust a card, Channel 1 Frost.
${modID}:Turbulence.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Lose !M! Focus. NL ${modID}:If_leftmost, add a [#efc851ff]Trick to your hand. Whenever you exhaust a card, Channel 1 Frost.

${modID}:UpDraft.NAME: Up Draft
${modID}:UpDraft.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Apply !M! Weak. NL Add a [#efc851ff]Ring to your hand.

${modID}:VolcanoSlider.NAME: Volcano Slider
${modID}:VolcanoSlider.DESCRIPTION: ${modID}:Crest_of_Fire. Exhaust ALL to the left of this card. Deal !D! damage. Deals !M! additional damage for each card exhausted.

${modID}:WallJump.NAME: Wall Jump
${modID}:WallJump.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block X times. NL Add X [#efc851ff]Rings to your hand.

${modID}:Whirlwind.NAME: Whirlwind
${modID}:Whirlwind.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage !M! times to ALL enemies.

${modID}:WindUpPunch.NAME: Wind Up Punch
${modID}:WindUpPunch.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Apply !M! Vulnerable. NL Add a [#efc851ff]Trick to your hand.

${modID}:Windmill.NAME: Windmill
${modID}:Windmill.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Randomize a card's cost in your hand for this turn.
